# Internal Medicine — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the role of Internal Medicine?", "complex adult disease"),

    ("What is category?", "adults"),
    ("What is role?", "complex adult disease"),
    ("What is sources/training?", "3 years residency"),
    ("What is note?", "Diagnosticians"),
]

for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):

    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
